record.context_brief: Minimum spectral radius of saturated graphs
record.original_question: If G is a K_{r+1}-saturated graph on n vertices, must its spectral radius satisfy lambda(G) >= lambda(S_{n,r-1}), with equality only when G is isomorphic to S_{n,r-1}?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 15 (Kim-Kim-Kostochka-O [89]). Let G be a K_{r+1}-saturated graph on n vertices. Then λ(G) ≥ λ(S_{n,r−1}), with equality if and only if G ≅ S_{n,r−1}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer r ≥ 2 and n ≥ r+1, let S_{n,r-1} denote the graph on n vertices obtained from a clique K_{r-1} on a vertex set S by adding n − (r−1) additional vertices, each of which is adjacent to every vertex of S and to no other vertex (equivalently, S_{n,r-1} = K_{r-1} ∨ \overline{K_{n-r+1}}, the join of a clique on r−1 vertices with an independent set of n−r+1 vertices). 

A graph G is called K_{r+1}-saturated if G contains no clique on r+1 vertices, but adding any non-edge of G creates such a clique. For a graph G, let λ(G) denote the spectral radius of its adjacency matrix (the largest eigenvalue of A(G)).

Prove or disprove: for every integer r ≥ 2 and every K_{r+1}-saturated graph G on n vertices,
   λ(G) ≥ λ(S_{n,r-1}),
with equality if and only if G is isomorphic to S_{n,r-1}.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (due to Kim, Kim, Kostochka, and O, 2020) appears to remain open in general. Partial progress is known: a sharp lower bound for K_4-saturated graphs (case r=3) was established by Kim–Kostochka–O–Shi–Wang (2022), and a 2024 paper in Discrete Mathematics handles the case of large r under additional conditions. No source found that resolves the full conjecture for all r and n.

status_evidence.title: K_{r+1}-saturated graphs with small spectral radius
status_evidence.snippet: Authors give a lower bound on spectral radii of K_{r+1}-saturated graphs which is asymptotically tight; conjecture that S_{n,r-1} is the minimizer.
status_evidence.claim: Original conjecture stated; only asymptotic bound proved.

status_evidence.title: A sharp lower bound for the spectral radius in K_4-saturated graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp lower bound established for the spectral radius of K_4-saturated graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for the case r=3.

status_evidence.title: The minimum spectral radius for K_{r+1}-saturated graphs with r ...
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a sufficient condition and confirms the conjecture in additional cases (2024).
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress toward the general conjecture.
